name: legal-page
title: Legal page
description: Legal page with a back link, title, last updated date, and a styled prose body with an on this page list.
usage: Privacy policies, terms and data processing pages. Put the text in as children (sections with an `h2` each, `h3` and `h4` inside, paragraphs, lists, `strong` lead-ins and links); the page styles them and builds the "On this page" list (from lg) from the `h2`s, marking the section being read and scrolling to one when clicked. Set `--header-offset` to the sticky header's height. LegalPageBody is the text and list alone.
avoid: The site's full policy text in examples
A dark or gray page background
notes:
The list scrolls on its own when it is taller than the window and fades at its edges (`fade-y`). A click scrolls
smoothly to the section, or jumps under reduced motion.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.

This placeholder policy shows how a legal page is laid out. Acme Inc. ("Acme," "we") explains here what it collects and why.

Summary

  • We collect account details and how you use the service.
  • We never sell your personal information.
  • You can ask us to export or delete your data at any time.

1. Information we collect

Information you give us

In short: the details you enter when you sign up or contact us.

This includes your name, email address, and anything you write to us.

Information collected automatically

Like most services, we log basic device and usage information to keep the service secure and reliable.

2. How we use information

We use it to provide and improve the service, to answer you, and to meet our legal obligations.

3. Contact us

Questions about this policy? Write to privacy@acme.dev.
